prompt_meta.title: GA Release Hardening: Repo Integrity Guardrails + Prisma Migration Discipline + Build/Release Gates (API + Web + Mobile)

owner_actions.when: after STEP-0012 report is shared with ChatGPT
owner_actions.instruction: Approve the GA release gates and the 'no db push' policy documented in ops/RELEASE_GATES.md and ops/DB_MIGRATION_POLICY.md. Approval only; no local execution.
Optionally enable branch protection rules on the repo (require CI green before merge). If owner cannot access repo settings, report as limitation.

step_objectives.goal: Prevent recurrence of corruption and establish GA-grade release discipline: repo integrity checks, database migration policy, and build gates that must pass on every change.
outcomes: Repo integrity scanner exists and runs locally + in CI (detect null bytes, empty critical files, JSON parse failures, missing required files)
Prisma discipline enforced: migrations are the source of truth (no schema changes via db push after this step)
A migration baseline strategy is implemented to reconcile current state safely (IDE chooses approach; must document)
Root build gates exist and are green (api/web/mobile as applicable)
Recovery playbooks exist: how to restore from corruption, how to reset local DB safely, how to re-seed
constraints: No new product features (no new domains/UI beyond what is needed for release gates and integrity).
Owner does not execute commands; IDE must run everything.
definition_of_done: Integrity guard: script/tool added + documented + enforced in CI
CI runs: lint + test + build + integrity + (optional) typecheck and fails fast on violations
Prisma: documented and enforced workflow: generate migrations for schema changes; CI rejects db push usage
Database reset/seed scripts are reliable and documented
Docs added: ops/RELEASE_GATES.md, ops/REPO_INTEGRITY.md, ops/DB_MIGRATION_POLICY.md, ops/DISASTER_RECOVERY.md

deliverables_outcomes.goal: Detect corruption early and stop bad commits.
requirements: Add an integrity check that detects: null bytes, empty critical files, malformed JSON, missing required repo contract files.
Add a 'critical files list' and enforce minimum size/non-empty checks.
Ensure it runs in CI and can be run locally.
acceptance_criteria: Report includes sample run output and what it checks
CI job exists and fails when corruption is simulated (IDE may demonstrate via a temporary test file and remove it)

deliverables_outcomes.goal: Stop db push drift and make DB changes reproducible.
requirements: Establish a canonical policy: migrations are required for schema changes.
Reconcile current schema state (post db push) into a safe baseline with migrations (IDE chooses: baseline migration, diff-based migration, or reset strategy; must document).
Update scripts so developers use migrate workflows, not db push.
Update CI to discourage/prevent db push (policy + detection).
acceptance_criteria: Fresh clone + setup can reach a working DB state using documented commands
Report includes evidence: schema sync using migrations, not db push

deliverables_outcomes.goal: Every app can build in CI and locally without manual steps.
requirements: Root build command(s) exist and pass (IDE decides exact commands).
CI runs build gates for api/web/mobile appropriately.
Ensure docker-compose.yml and infra scripts remain valid.
acceptance_criteria: Report includes commands run + exit codes

deliverables_outcomes.goal: When things go wrong, we recover fast.
requirements: Document: how to recover from file corruption, how to restore critical files, how to verify integrity.
Document: how to reset local DB safely and re-seed.
Document: how to verify a clean working state end-to-end.
acceptance_criteria: Docs exist and are specific (no placeholders)
Report references docs and highlights key procedures

tasks.name: Repo integrity scanner + CI enforcement
tasks.objective: Add integrity checker and make CI fail on corruption signals.
constraints: Must run fast and be deterministic
acceptance: Integrity check runs locally and in CI; documented

tasks.name: Prisma migration baseline + policy
tasks.objective: Remove reliance on db push and establish migrations as canonical.
constraints: Must be reproducible from a fresh checkout
acceptance: Local setup path uses migrations; policy doc written

tasks.name: Release build gates
tasks.objective: Ensure api/web/mobile build commands exist and pass; wire into CI.
acceptance: CI build gates pass; root scripts documented

tasks.name: Recovery playbooks
tasks.objective: Create disaster recovery docs for corruption + DB reset/seed + verification.
acceptance: Docs complete and referenced in report

tasks.name: Docs + manifest + report
tasks.objective: Update manifest and produce a complete report.

final_instruction_to_ide: Execute this prompt exactly. Do not delegate any execution to the owner. Choose implementation freely. Update ops/manifest.json and write a complete reports/STEP-0012.report.json with no placeholders.
